---
name: New adapter request
about: Ask for support for another AI coding agent CLI
title: "Support <tool name>"
labels: new-adapter
assignees: ""
---

**Tool name and binary** (e.g. "Goose", `goose`)

**Do you have it installed and have used it at least once?**
Adapters in this project are only built after inspecting real local session
data — see CONTRIBUTING.md. If you have the tool installed, this issue can move
much faster; if not, that's fine, just say so.

**Where does it store session data locally, if you know?**
(e.g. a path like `~/.something/sessions`, a SQLite file, JSONL files — anything
you can find helps. Not required.)

**What's the tool's own resume command?**
(e.g. what it prints when you exit a session, or `--help` output showing a
`resume`/`continue` flag)

**Anything else worth knowing** (odd formats, known quirks, whether it's
open source so the storage format can be read from source instead)
